The final control restores the baseline custody versions.

initialFailures.cause: The first test started before the final Worker release build finished.
The transport proxy applied first-attempt assertions to the independent recovery wallet. Its diagnostic-order assertion also assumed the old handshake.

independentSignatureVerification.verifier: Node.js crypto Ed25519 with independent NEP-413 Borsh encoding

limitations: Three samples per arm do not establish percentiles or guarantees.
Sequential arms can vary with network and provider scheduling.
Fresh wallets do not prove cold Workers. Worker cold starts were not controlled.
Nested spans overlap and must not be added. The protocol spans include transport.
Application clocks do not advance during synchronous CPU work. Zero spans do not imply zero work.
The measured D1 events cover bound-root admission and execution, not all backend D1 calls.
Location hints are observed requests, not proof of physical colocation.
Four candidate-window tenant-root active-state reads used the prior Router version. This source file and handler were unchanged. All changed Yao execution paths used the candidate versions.

decision.reason: Candidate Yao median exceeded both baseline and final control. Preparation slowed enough to offset shorter execution. Retain production transport; preserve candidate only in artifacts.
